profile.headline: Founder @ ByePJ  (byepj.com) | Lead Engineer @ Dscout | Building what matters now: AI Solutions, Creative Design, Cultural Impact
profile.summary:
Lead Engineer & Founder building products at the intersection of technology, design, and culture.
I specialize in full-stack development (TypeScript/React, Elixir, Node, Python) with deep experience leading teams, scaling systems, and integrating AI into workflows. At dscout, I guide engineering strategy and product execution; as Founder of ByePJ, I create tech-driven brand experiences that reflect what matters now.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead engineering efforts across front-end and back-end systems, guiding product development and team execution.

What I do:
	•	Lead team rituals, planning, and project delivery.
	•	Drove migration from legacy UI to Builder UI with GraphQL
                 and consolidated backend data.
	•	Contribute to full-stack (Elixir, Python, TypeScript)
	•	Run the FE engineering forum to align best practices and
                 shared architecture while fostering org communication
	•	Build AI evaluation and compliance pipelines/workflows
	•	Apply AI tools to optimize coding, reviews, and workflows

positions.title: Founder (byePJ.com)
positions.description: ByePJ (byePJ.com) is a creative technology brand focused on building experiences that matter now. The work blends brand building, cultural perspective, and consulting with the development of tech-driven solutions that reflect what people need today. ByePJ operates at the intersection of technology, design, and culture—crafting systems, insights, and experiences that bridge creativity with meaningful impact.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Entrepreneurship · Business Strategy · Team Building · Consulting · System Architecture · Creative Direction · Cross-Cultural Communication Skills
